head: b8c3e53df81f2e5a9af6c680434c7c9a15686d35
notes: Re-verified at HEAD b8c3e53. Regression fixed: the shared rule and the #identity-auth-status/#identity-product override were requalified to '#identity-bar > span#identity-auth-status, #identity-bar > span#identity-product', which ties the shared rule's specificity (2 ids + 1 type) and wins via source order (declared after the shared rule). Computed styles confirm the fix directly: getComputedStyle(#identity-auth-status).flexShrink === '1' and getComputedStyle(#identity-product).flexShrink === '1', while account/profile/model/project all read flexShrink === '3'. This was checked via computed CSSOM values, not source text, so auth-status/product are confirmed to genuinely shrink three times slower than the other segments at narrow width.
